## Appearance

Shirley is a small schoolteacher with a pointed chin, big wonderful eyes, and long red hair that she wears in a braid or in smooth, ruddy ripples.

## History

Born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), Shirley taught school for two years, working earnestly and faithfuly. She established a close bond with her imaginative pupil [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and successfully navigated various classroom challenges. After resigning from her teaching post to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), she helped orchestrate a romantic reunion and wedding for [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). While walking home from the wedding with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), she experienced a quiet moment of romantic awakening.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P1](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P4](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P6](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P9](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0009), +244 more_

## Quotes

> "In the years to come thy memory will shine like a star over my lonely life, as that last story we read together says. Diana, wilt thou give me a lock of thy jet-black tresses in parting to treasure forevermore?"
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010)

> "Fare thee well, my beloved friend. Henceforth we must be as strangers though living side by side. But my heart will ever be faithful to thee."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P12](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0012)

> "That is all there is left in life for me, now that my friend has been ruthlessly torn from me. In school I can look at her and muse over days departed."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017)

> "I’d be able to help you so much now and spare you in a hundred ways. I could find it in my heart to wish I had been, just for that."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P40](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0040)

> “When I’ve finished these exercises I’ll run down and chat awhile with Mrs. Lynde,” said Anne. “I had intended to study some Latin composition tonight but it can wait.”
>
> — Shirley — [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P7](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0007)

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--shirley.md)

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) is Anne's closest schoolmate and bosom friend, maintaining a deep bond despite past orders from her mother that temporarily forced them into secret meetings. They frequently share confidences regarding local gossip, their futures, and love, such as when [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) reveals her secret engagement to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md). As they face upcoming separations for higher education and marriage, their friendship remains a supportive and emotional cornerstone for both.

- Friend of — bosom friends and schoolmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P32](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0032), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060), +2 more</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

Initially intense academic rivals competing for top marks and academic honors at school and Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eventually transition into a close friendship. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) shows delight when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resigns from her teaching post to pursue college alongside him. Their relationship gradually develops subtle romantic undertones, highlighted by a quiet moment of romantic awakening as they walk home together following Miss Lavendar's wedding.

- Rival of — intense academic rivalry for top marks in school  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>
- Friend of — friendship (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVI Around the Bend P46](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0046), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--shirley.md)

[Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) is one of Anne's young pupils, bonding with her on her very first day of teaching when he gifts her orchids. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) acts as a mentor to the imaginative boy, appreciating his creative nature and sharing visits with him to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Their deep mutual affection and understanding make him one of her most cherished students throughout her teaching term.

- Friend of — student who likes his teacher (since v2)  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>
- Mentor of (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVI Around the Bend P35](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)</sub>
